news.analysis: Mahomes threw touchdowns to Rashee Rice, Emmett Johnson, and Noah Gray without turning the ball over. He also surpassed 300 passing yards for the first time this season. After failing to throw a touchdown against the Chargers in Week 6, Mahomes returned to QB1 production against Denver. He's back.
news.contents: Patrick Mahomes completed 30 of 41 passes for 321 yards and three touchdowns while rushing twice for six yards in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
news.title: Patrick Mahomes throws three touchdowns in Week 8

news.contents: Kansas City Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes was able to rebound during Sunday's game against the Denver Broncos. Before this game, Mahomes hadn't thrown a touchdown in back-to-back games. The two-time MVP was carving up the Broncos defense through the first three quarters of this game. The Chiefs were unable to finish the job, but this was still a masterful performance by Mahomes. He completed 30-of-41 passing attempts for 321 yards with three touchdowns and zero interceptions in the loss. ...
news.title: Patrick Mahomes Bounces Back with Strong Performance in Week 8
